_comment: The Fleet Manager persists a model under a provider key. The desktop's
both independently decide which provider(s) positively own that id before
allowing it through. Unknown ids must remain unclaimed so future/private
models pass through; a claimed id must be rejected under every other provider.
Each row is a model-to-owner assertion. Both loaders also derive the complete
provider x model foreignness matrix from it, so adding a provider or changing
a matcher cannot silently leave a cross-provider acceptance hole.

ownershipCases.why: The positive ownership vocabulary that makes the Fleet Manager's per-provider model map safe without turning an evolving CLI catalog into a closed whitelist.

ownershipCases.name: Claude default alias
ownershipCases.note: The legacy default alias remains Claude-owned.

ownershipCases.name: Claude Haiku alias
ownershipCases.note: A Claude alias cannot reach a non-Claude manager.

ownershipCases.name: Claude Sonnet alias
ownershipCases.note: The common legacy manager model is Claude-owned.

ownershipCases.name: Claude one-million Sonnet alias
ownershipCases.note: The context-marker alias remains a Claude model identity at this boundary.

ownershipCases.name: Claude Opus alias
ownershipCases.note: The standard Opus shorthand is Claude-owned.

ownershipCases.name: Claude OpusPlan alias
ownershipCases.note: The planning alias remains part of Claude's vocabulary.

ownershipCases.name: Claude Fable alias
ownershipCases.note: Fable is Claude-owned even though its context behavior is separately modeled.

ownershipCases.name: concrete Claude id
ownershipCases.note: Concrete Claude ids are covered by the prefix, not by the alias list.

ownershipCases.name: Codex GPT family
ownershipCases.note: The normal Codex GPT spelling is Codex-owned.

ownershipCases.name: Codex o-number family
ownershipCases.note: An o-number model is Codex-owned.

ownershipCases.name: Codex o-number variant
ownershipCases.note: The o-number matcher covers variants as well as the bare id.

ownershipCases.name: Codex prefix family
ownershipCases.note: Codex-prefixed ids remain Codex-owned.

ownershipCases.name: legacy compact GPT spelling
ownershipCases.note: The compact GPT spelling is still a Codex id.

ownershipCases.name: trimmed case-insensitive Codex id
ownershipCases.note: Config whitespace and casing must not change ownership.

ownershipCases.name: Copilot auto
ownershipCases.note: Copilot's account-gated catalog has exactly one portable explicit id.

ownershipCases.name: shared provider-model form
ownershipCases.note: The string alone cannot distinguish OpenCode from Pi, so both honestly claim it.

ownershipCases.name: provider-model form with a colon suffix
ownershipCases.note: The slash-form vocabulary permits a colon in the model component.

ownershipCases.name: unknown private model
ownershipCases.note: No positive owner is not invalid: every provider passes a private or future id through.

ownershipCases.name: blank model
ownershipCases.note: There is no model id to own or reject.

ownershipCases.name: incomplete provider-model form
ownershipCases.note: A malformed slash form is unclaimed rather than guessed at.
